__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: The ground cracks under the weight of a grey hammer lying here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: This massive hammer is incredibly hard, heavy, and utterly grey and featureless.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: hammer sledge grey

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A rolled piece of violet parchment lies on the floor.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The scroll is written on soft violet parchment that has a pleasing smell to it.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: scroll violet

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Lying on the ground is a jet black stone tablet.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The tablet is an unreflective black rectangular piece of stone, with strange
writings etched deep into its surface.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: tablet scroll black

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: You see a scroll written in an alien tongue.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The scroll has writings on it that you cannot comprehend.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: scroll githyanki
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.short_descr: a scroll with githyanki writings on it

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small amulet lies here in the dirt.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The amulet is a small circular object made from some bizarre metallic alloy.
It is inscribed with various symbols and raised images of snakes, tortured
victims, and other things too horrible to describe.

Stenciled in the center is an unpronounceable name which it would behoove you
not to utter aloud.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: amulet demon

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: On the ground is a small talisman which radiates a tangible evil.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The talisman is a red circular stone object hanging from a metallic chain.  It
seems to pulse with a life of its own, and you feel uncomfortable being anywhere
near it.

Engraved in the center is one word.  Merely reading the word induces fright.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: talisman devilish

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A flat-bladed silvery knife lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The knife is forged from a strange silvery metal the likes of which you have
never seen in your own world.  It is incredibly sharp and hard, yet feels almost
fluid to the touch.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: knife silvery

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A sharp-looking silvery dagger lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The dagger is forged from a strange silvery metal the likes of which you have
never seen in your own world.  It is incredibly sharp and hard, yet feels almost
fluid to the touch.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: dagger silvery

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Light glints off the edge of a razor-sharp sword.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The sword is forged from a strange silvery metal.  It barely measures an inch
across at its widest point, yet it is totally inflexible and razor-sharp.  It
could probably cut through stone.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: sword thin
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.short_descr: an extremely sharp and thin sword

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A heavy yet thinly bladed two-handed sword lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The sword is forged from a strange silvery metal.  It barely measures two inches
across at its widest point, yet it is totally inflexible and razor sharp.  It
could probably cut through stone.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: sword thin two two-handed

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A silvery sword gleams unnaturally with an alien light.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The sword is forged from a strange silvery metal the likes of which you have
never seen in your own world.  It is incredibly sharp and hard, yet feels almost
fluid to the touch.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: sword silvery two-handed

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A rusty iron flail with wicked barbs on it tears at the ground.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This hideous weapon has claimed many lives.  You can tell from the bloodstains
dried into the iron and from the residue of flesh that hangs from the many
barbs on it.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: flail barbed iron

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: You feel tendrils of evil emanating from a wicked blade.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The blade of this sword is a featureless gray.  As you touch it you feel an
evil presence reaching out to consume your soul.

Maybe picking it up wasn't such a good idea.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: sword gith two-handed
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.short_descr: the unholy sword of the githyanki

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: The room is lit by a hot blue flame coming from a small stone.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This stone burns with an flame that emits great heat, yet it can be held with
ease.  The flame creates a light that allows you to see for miles.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: stone flame

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Twinkling powder floats before your eyes.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: You see the residue of the astral plane.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: powder astral

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: An intricately fashioned splint mail vest lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This splint mail has been expertly and ornately fashioned from the highest
quality of steels.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: vest splint

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: An intricately fashioned splint mail skirt lies here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This splint mail has been expertly and ornately fashioned from the highest
quality of steels.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: skirt splint

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A pair of intricately fashioned splint mail sleeves lie here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This splint mail has been expertly and ornately fashioned from the highest
quality of steels.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: sleeves splint
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.short_descr: a pair of splint mail sleeves

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A pair of painstakingly designed ornate gauntlets lie here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
These gauntlets have been expertly and ornately fashioned from the highest
quality of steels.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: gauntlets ornate
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.short_descr: a pair of ornately designed gauntlets

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A decaying hunk of cracked leather has been discarded here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The ancient vest is barely intact.  All of the leather has cracked and dried
to a husk.  It is covered with stains, burns, scorch marks, and blood.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: vest cracked leather
__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.short_descr: a decaying vest made from cracked leather

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A tall glass flask holds a translucent violet fluid.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The violet fluid inside shifts and swirls.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: potion violet

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small vial contains a murky, sludge-like substance.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The murky liquid inside this vial looks a lot like sewer water.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: potion vial murky

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: An octagonal vial holds a silvery-colored fluid that reflects light.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: The octagonal vial contains a silvery-colored liquid that shimmers in the light.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: potion silvery

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: Someone has dropped a delicious-looking chocolate mint here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
This mint is made from the finest of chocolates, surrounding a cool peppermint
interior that must be savored, not swallowed.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: mint chocolate

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small black metal pentagram has been left here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description:
The pentagram is a small circular hoop that surrounds a five-pointed star.
Inscribed on its exterior loop are markings in an alien tongue.

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: pentagram

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.description: A small pouch rots away on the floor here.

__class__/rom24.world_classes.ExtraDescr.description: You think you see glints of metal through the holes...

__class__/rom24.handler_item.Items.name: pouch rotting
